import os
import requests
from authlib.integrations.requests_client import OAuth2Session

def oauth_callback(payload, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    client_id = config.get('client_id', os.getenv('AUTH0_CLIENT_ID'))
    client_secret = config.get('client_secret', os.getenv('AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET'))
    redirect_uri = config.get('redirect_uri', os.getenv('AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI'))
    auth0_domain = config.get('auth0_domain', os.getenv('AUTH0_DOMAIN', 'your-tenant.auth0.com'))

    session = OAuth2Session(client_id, client_secret, scope='openid profile email', redirect_uri=redirect_uri)
    token_endpoint = f'https://{auth0_domain}/oauth/token'
    result = session.fetch_token(token_endpoint, authorization_response=payload.get('callback_url'), client_secret=client_secret)
    return result
